purpose: Design-time hardware facts and open questions. This file is not served at runtime.

confirmed: LCD character display with 4 rows and 20 columns
SG90 servo drives the door lock mechanism
The lock has no independent latch-position sensor
Servo position 0 degrees represents locked and 90 degrees represents unlocked
The last stable locked or unlocked state is persisted and restored after restart
4x4 keypad accepts PIN and local actions
open_questions: PIN length, retry limit and lockout duration

confirmed: Step motor simulates opening and closing the roof cover
Water sensor reports whether rain is present
One local button toggles roof movement
open_questions: Real position feedback versus time estimation
Water sensor threshold and debounce strategy

confirmed: MQ2 reports gas and smoke levels
Flame sensor reports flame detection
DHT11 reports temperature and humidity
Buzzer emits the local warning
One local button temporarily mutes the buzzer
Remote mute durations are limited to 60, 180, 300, 600 or 1800 seconds
The local mute button uses the 60-second safe default
The buzzer turns on automatically for alarm or emergency risk while armed
A bounded mute can be activated before a hazard and suppresses the buzzer until its deadline without suppressing hazard telemetry
The mute can be cancelled immediately from the app or by pressing the local button again
open_questions: MQ2 calibration and safe warning thresholds
Flame sensor threshold and debounce strategy
Whether buzzer output feedback is available; the current contract reports requested output only

confirmed: Soil-moisture sensing
Reservoir-level sensing
Irrigation pump
Local pump input
open_questions: Soil-moisture sensor model, calibration range and installation-dependent wet/dry thresholds
Water-level measurement type and whether a continuous normalized value is available
Dry-run, current or flow feedback; the current pump state reports requested output only
Local button gestures and the approved default watering, maximum-runtime and cooldown values

confirmed: Developed on Device Simulator first with a PC webcam and microphone (H.264 + AAC, docs/architecture/camera-contract.md)
Audio capture only; no speaker or two-way talk
open_questions: Physical hardware that meets h264_aac_cmaf_v1 (ESP32-S3 cannot; ESP32-P4 is a candidate)
Microphone model, RTC module and storage card for the physical device
